method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Wash and dice the mixed peppers. Use ready-to-eat canned sweetcorn, drained before weighing; keep both ready for assembly.
Use canned tuna in spring water. Drain it before weighing, then break it into small flakes with a fork.
Use the measured reduced-sugar BBQ sauce as a ready-to-eat sauce or dressing; stir in all the measured olive oil. Keep chilled sauces refrigerated until assembly.
